_doc: Enemy morale, read by scripts/combat/morale.gd. A losing enemy breaks ONCE per fight: when its structure (the hp of its blocks over their maximum, structure.gd) is at or under break_structure (0.95: a twentieth of the blocks' hp gone. It was 0.9, the damage the old hull pool's break took, tests/tool_balance.gd, but the player-like ship of tests/tool_standoff.gd takes 1.7 to 3.6 hp a second off 1,300 to 2,900 hp, so at 0.9 the median stage 3-5 fight ran 100 to 180 s; 0.93 was worse than 0.95 in the same runs), or when no weapon of it has been able to fire for unarmed_s seconds. It then rolls its style (a ship with no weapon able to fire rolls its fight weight times unarmed_fight, 0: a disarmed ship yields or runs, never fights on, unless its style can do neither; one that fights on and then loses every weapon for unarmed_s breaks once more, the same way, fights-end 2026-11) (styles: the weights of surrender, flee and fight; a design picks one with "morale" in its `ai` entry, else `default`; a style may also set its own `spool_s` and `fades`, see FLEE). SURRENDER: it holds fire and cuts throttle and offers `offer` for offer_s seconds (Y accepts; any damage you deal to it, or the time running out, and it fights to the end). The offer is credits [min, max] (base, tier 1: the campaign multiplies it), one of `extra` (item and a count range) and, with part_chance, one of its intact parts. FLEE: it turns its stern to you and burns while its jump drive charges for spool_s seconds; the charge holds (Morale.spool_hold, the rule that also holds the player's own J spool) while every engine of the ship is out (disabled, offline or unpowered), or its helm is down (none working and powered), or every crew member aboard is down; held held_surrender_s seconds in a row, it is cornered and surrenders instead (the offer above). At full charge it is gone (moved escape_distance px away). The style `ghost` (the Hollow's ghost ships, data/enemy_tables.json) is a flight that always happens and is short: it never surrenders or fights on, and its drive spools for its own spool_s (6 s) with the same engine, helm and crew holds; `fades` means it thins back into the Hollow, which counts as a won fight with nothing to loot or salvage (Campaign.fight_done). The Leviathans and the Hollow's own beacon warden (a spec tagged :warden, Shipgen.build) keep `hollow`, which never breaks. The Lattice wardens fly `warden` (fights-end 2026-11; they were `hollow` and 95-100% of their fights ran to the cap): guardians who stand aside or withdraw to the gate when beaten, never fight on, and pay a lane's small toll (credits and fuel), not a pirate's ransom. CAPTURED: if its crew was aboard and every member is down (or none is left) for captured_s seconds, the ship goes dark and is yours. refused_banner_s: how long the banner "They take that as a no" stays up. hail_s: [from, to] seconds into the fight in which a generated enemy shows its hail (after the threat banner). lines: what each faction says (see its own _doc).

lines._doc: What an enemy says. Per faction of data/enemy_tables.json: `title` ("Captain", or "" for a ship with nobody to name: then it is 'The <ship>'), and the lines of `hail` (at the start of the fight, for the hail_s window), `surrender` (the offer), `flee` (as it spools its jump drive) and `refuse` (when the offer is refused). A ship says the same line every time: the line is picked by the hash of its name. {captain} is its captain's name and {ship} its ship's. The captain is the first of a generated ship's crew plan (or the `captain` of its design's `ai`). A ship without a faction (an authored design, no `faction` in its ai) keeps the plain lines in morale.gd. Wardens and Leviathans never break (style hollow): their surrender, flee and refuse lines are there for a style that might. The Hollow's ghosts fade (style ghost): their flee lines are the fade lines (they never surrender or refuse). The ten race flagships (data/flagships.json) have lines of their own under flagship_<race>, which their design's ai faction names; they never flee. Their style flagship_<race> yields (surrender 1.0: a fight that nothing else ends would run to the cap, since the defeat line is half the blocks of a very big hull) with the `offer` block of the style in place of the global one (credits, extra, part_chance: the race's own goods), at the structure the design's ai `break_structure` names (morale.gd break_at), and the player may refuse it and fight on.

rustfangs.title: Captain
hail: Cargo, credits, or the good kind of scrap. You pick the order.
This is a polite robbery. The impolite one costs extra.
Hold still and we'll only take what you can spare. Which is all of it.
surrender: Enough! Take it and let us go.
Alright, alright, you win! Take the lot and leave us the engine.
Don't shoot! I only joined for the dental plan!
My cousin is going to hear about this. Take the cargo and go!
Mercy! Take the cut, take the scrap, take the hat!
flee: Not today! Not today! Not today!
Burn it, burn it, get us out of here!
This isn't over! It's just somewhere else, and later!
refuse: Then we're back to the shooting part.

clans.title: Captain
hail: You're in clan water, friend. The toll's a fair one. Ask anyone. Ask my cousin.
Hold up! Nothing personal. It's a family matter.
Easy now. We're only here for the salvage rights, and your ship, and the salvage rights to your ship.
surrender: Ma'd skin me if I lost the {ship}. Take it and go.
That's enough! Take the cargo, take the credits, tell nobody.
We yield! Mind the paint, it's still wet.
Cousin, stop shooting! No, YOU stop shooting!
Fair play, fair play. Clan law says we pay up. Take it.
flee: Time to be elsewhere, Pa! Pa, hit the jump!
She'll hold together long enough to leave. Probably.
We'll settle this at the next family dinner!
refuse: Ha! Clans don't take charity, and don't give it.
Then it's a feud, and you started it.

concord.title: Captain
hail: Unregistered vessel, you are in Concord space. Stand by for inspection.
This is a routine stop. Please hold your fire, your breath and your paperwork.
By the authority of the Concord, you are requested to heave to. The request is binding.
surrender: We are standing down. Please note this in your report.
Cease fire! We will submit an offer in lieu of a claim. Form 7B to follow.
{ship} yields. Kindly do not damage the registry.
We have no authority to continue. Take the stores, and go.
Hostilities are suspended pending review. Please accept this.
flee: Withdrawing to a position of procedural safety.
Retreat is not defeat. It is a change of venue.
Jump drive spooling. We will be filing a complaint.
refuse: Your refusal has been noted, and entered into the record.

lumen.title: Captain
hail: You are interesting. Please do not stop being interesting.
We saw you coming a long time ago. Last Tuesday, in fact.
The light has noticed you. We are merely its hands.
surrender: The experiment is concluded. Take your findings and let us go.
We yield. The results are... instructive.
Enough. Let it be written in light. Take the offering.
The door is closing on this one. Take what we can spare.
You win. We shall be insufferable about it later.
flee: A tactical refraction. We will return at a different angle.
We are leaving. Please do not consider this an ending.
Folding the light. Do not wait up.

barons.title: Captain
hail: Dreadfully sorry to trouble you. We are collecting a tax. It is a new tax. It is for us.
Stand by, please. His Lordship has taken an interest in your cargo.
Do hold still. It is rude to flee a gentleman who is robbing you.
surrender: Good heavens, enough! Take it and let us go. Think of the upholstery.
A gentleman knows when he is beaten. Here. Take it.
We concede the point, and the cargo, and a small cheque.
Please, stop! The champagne cannot take it.
Quite enough, I think. Do take something for your trouble.
flee: Well! One has never been so insulted. We are leaving.
Make way for the yacht! Make way, I say!
We shall retire to the country and pretend this never happened.
refuse: Then we are no longer civil.

hail: Gate-lane closed. State your business, or leave it.
This lane is held. We have held it for forty years. We are not tired.
Turn back. We were told to be polite once. We have forgotten how.
surrender: Standing down. The lane is yours to pass; take what the road is owed.
Enough. We stand aside. Pass, and keep to the lane.
The gate does not fall for this. We yield the lane, this once.
flee: Withdrawing to the gate.
Falling back to the beacon. The lane will hold without us.
refuse: Then we hold, as long as we are able.

hail: It opens a channel and plays your own hail back, a little late.
Static, in the shape of a word you almost know.
A voice on the channel says 'come to the Lantern Reach'. It is not the right voice.
surrender: It does not answer.
flee: The ship thins like breath on glass.
It drifts, and is not there.

hail: A low note comes through the hull. It is not a message. It is a feeling.
Something very large clears its throat, in the pipes.
The water in your pipes hums back. The thing is listening.
surrender: It lets go.
flee: It sinks away.

flagship_kett.title: Captain
hail: Nine cells hum as one. Come and be counted.
The hive does not shoot first. The hive is already shooting.
Twelve hands to a gun. Count yours.
surrender: The hive yields a cell. Only a cell.
Enough. Take the cell and go.
flee: The hive does not run. It moves house.

flagship_emberkin.title: Matron
hail: It's cosy in here. Won't you come in?
Everything that burns is welcome at the Kiln.
The Kiln is warm. You are cold. This can be fixed.
surrender: Enough! Bank the fires! Take what you like.
The Kiln yields, and it will remember.
flee: Damp the fires! Out!
refuse: Then you will be warm after all.
The Kiln does not take no.

flagship_prismatic.title: Choirmaster
hail: The seventh note is yours. Hold it.
We have been singing since before you were built.
Listen. It will help.
surrender: The piece is over. Take the score.
A rest, then. Take what you came for.
flee: Diminuendo. Out.

flagship_basalt.title: Foreman
hail: The Anvil holds. Come and hit it.
Stone does not hurry.
Front plate is thick. Do not take that as an invitation to the back.
surrender: The Anvil yields. Once. Take it and go.
Enough. The stone has made its point.
flee: Stone does not run.

flagship_sporeling.title: Elder
hail: Breathe in. It is only us.
Mother's Bloom has opened for you.
We did not mean the air. It was a gift.
surrender: The Bloom closes. Take the seed.
Enough, enough! Take the cuttings!
flee: Spore, spore, spore!
refuse: Then the Bloom will open further.

flagship_mire.title: Old Mother
hail: She is slow. You will come to love it.
The Tide does not hurry. The Tide arrives.
Mind the wet. It minds you.
surrender: Enough. Take what the Tide brought.
The water has had its say.
flee: The tide goes out.
refuse: She will mend. You will not.

flagship_fenn.title: Broker
hail: Everything has a price. Even leaving. Especially leaving.
A fair fight is a fair price. I'm told.
Browse! Don't touch! Shoot, if you must!
surrender: Wait, wait! Let's talk! Name your price!
Fine! Take the till and call it even!
flee: Closing! Closing!
refuse: I'll take that as an opening bid.

flagship_gauntling.title: Overseer
hail: Please remain calm. The drones will be with you shortly.
Spare Parts Prime. Everything repaired, nothing returned.
Scheduled maintenance has begun. Yours.
surrender: Component failure. Please accept compensation.
Overseer Nine yields. Please do not blame the drones.
flee: Rescheduling.

flagship_grundl.title: Hauler-Chief
hail: Forward. That's the whole plan.
Mind the bow.
The Barge doesn't stop. The Barge arrives.
surrender: Hold! Hold! We'll haul your goods for free!
Enough! Take the cargo and let us stop!
flee: Hard astern!

flagship_human.title: Commodore
hail: Heave to and be boarded, or be corrected.
Concord Ascendant. You are on an unregistered course.
The Commodore sees you. The Commodore is not impressed.
surrender: The Commodore will accept terms. Formally.
Marines, stand down. Terms are being drafted.
flee: Withdraw in good order.
